name: std/time
description: Time: the calendar and its formatting, the high-resolution counter, the stopwatch, and timers.
residual: Created 2026-08-27. In: Dates from std/base, the clocks from std/system. Clock stays in std/runtime -- the kernel needs it before any library does. Missing and worth adding: monotonic time and a timezone database; the calendar itself (Dates) is already complete.
